pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Matter? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Matter.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Matter.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Matter.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Matter.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Light.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Light.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Heat.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
